Maya Chen: Quick heads up — Meridian QBR scheduled Tue 4/14 10am PT. Need slide list, action owners, and one demo. Can someone own deck polish + exec bullets?

Tom Jenkins: I can own deck polish. Will pull last QBR slides and update metrics. ETA EOD Mon for first pass.

Alexa Patel: I'll own account health + onboarding status. Need latest activation funnel numbers and renewal signal flags. @Maya can you confirm which cohorts to include?

Maya Chen: Include pilot customers + expansion accounts (top 10 ARR). Also call out three renewal-risk accounts flagged last week (Meridian, Harborline, Tactile). Add short remediation bullets.

Noah Rossi: I'll handle demo and enablement notes. Planning a 6min demo — who can help with data access?

Maya Chen: @Noah Rossi ask eng-ops for read-only view. @Tom Jenkins add placeholder slide 'demo runbook' and I'll paste step-by-step.

QBR Bot: Reminder: QBR template v2 at https://redwood.slides/qbr-template-v2 :thumbsup: 

Tom Jenkins: Added placeholder slides. Pushed update to shared drive: /QBRs/Meridian/2026-04-14. @Alexa do you have the funnel numbers? If not I'll add placeholders.

Alexa Patel: Pulling numbers now. Quick note: onboarding time-to-value improved 18% QoQ. Will include cohort table and call out 3 open integration tickets.

Maya Chen: Important: include renewal ask in exec slide — propose 6-mo discount vs. extended training credits. Need approval from Sales.

Ben Sales: I'm in — can present renewal proposal + commercial ask if you want. Ping me for a quick sync.

Maya Chen: Added to owners list: deck polish (Tom), account health (Alexa), demo (Noah), commercial ask (Ben). Can everyone add 2-3 bullet risks by EOD Mon?

Tom Jenkins: Will do. Quick ask: can someone review slide 3 wording for exec-friendly phrasing? @Matthew Comm?

Matthew Comm: Happy to review, will skim tonight.

Alexa Patel: Putting risk bullets in thread: 1) delayed feature adoption, 2) low seats per org, 3) open integration ticket blocking Demo. I'll link PRs and support tickets.

Noah Rossi: Demo depends on sandbox refresh — filed infra ticket #4567. If not ready, fallback is recorded demo video.

Maya Chen: Rehearsal slot? Propose Mon 11am PT for run-through (30m). Who's in?

Tom Jenkins: In.

Alexa Patel: In.

Noah Rossi: In.

Ben Sales: In for the second half.

Maya Chen: Great. Last: capture action log in the kickoff doc. Minimal template below — please paste into /QBRs/Meridian/2026-04-14/kickoff.md

```
Owner | Action | Due
Tom J | Deck polish + exec bullets | 2026-04-13 EOD
Alexa P | Health metrics + cohorts | 2026-04-13 EOD
Noah R | Demo prep + fallback video | 2026-04-13 EOD
Ben S | Renewal proposal draft | 2026-04-13 noon
Maya C | Exec alignment + runbook | 2026-04-13 EOD
```

Tom Jenkins: LGTM. Adding to doc now.

Maya Chen: Thanks everyone. I'll ping execs after rehearsal to confirm attendance. :sparkles:

QBR Bot: Scheduled rehearsal reminder for 2026-04-13 18:00 UTC.
